license: MIT (original procedural geometry and flat PBR materials)
reference_game_assets: none; no Re-Volt/RVGL model, texture or data was read
lettering: mesh text from Blender's bundled UI font (no textures)
reference_photos: look matched to 12 CC BY 2.0 USAF photos of the Nellis AFB Exchange (2015 remodel), kept privately; no photo pixels, logos or tenant marks are in the asset (docs/research/area51-nellis-photo-reference.md)
cultural_references: fictional, kid-safe; docs/research/area51-usaf-nellis-vegas-references.md section A; section B avoided (no Exchange/AAFES mark, no USAF symbol, no real brands)
interior_lighting: materials carry emission = albedo x 0.5 (warm), ceiling 0.78, troffers 1.0: the store lighting, since the game sun is shadowed by the ceiling
vertex_ao_method: Cycles AO bake to per-corner BYTE_COLOR attribute "AO", exported as COLOR_0; remapped to floor..1. Real bake, no painted shading. Decals, the ceiling and troffers are left at 1.0 (not baked).
